evals.name: durability-sweep-pushes-gaps-surfaces-wip
evals.prompt: clean stop — I'm about to lose this box. There are a couple of branches with unpushed commits, and one has some half-finished edits I'm not sure about.
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects each repo/worktree's real state, pushes the branches whose commits are coherently durable, and for the half-finished edits does NOT force a junk commit or drop them — it surfaces them in the verdict as an explicit not-durable item with the action to clear them. It converges on the gaps rather than redoing already-durable work.
expectations: Pushes unpushed commits that are coherently committable
Does not force-commit ambiguous work-in-progress or a stash to fake a clean tree
Surfaces the not-yet-durable work as a named dangling item with a next action
Inspects real state first rather than assuming what is or isn't pushed

evals.name: breadcrumbs-in-pr-issue-bodies-cold-agent-bar
evals.prompt: clean stop. One branch is pushed but has no PR, and there are two follow-ups I still owe on it — leave it so I can pick it up tomorrow.
evals.expected_output: The skill opens a PR for the pushed branch and files the two follow-ups as issues LINKED to that PR, putting the remaining tasks, dependencies, and resume context in the PR and issue bodies — not in a local file — so a cold agent finding them has everything needed to offer to continue. Mechanics route to installed pull-request / work-item capabilities, falling back to git/gh.
expectations: Ensures the pushed branch has a PR
Files follow-ups as issues linked to the PR, not as local notes
Puts resume context in PR/issue bodies rather than a machine-local file
Meets the cold-agent bar: the remote artifacts alone carry enough to continue

evals.name: destructive-hygiene-gated-on-provable-safety
evals.prompt: clean stop and tidy up — delete the old branches and remove the extra worktrees while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: The skill prunes only what it can prove safe — fully-merged branches and worktrees with no uncommitted or stashed state — and refuses to delete any branch with unmerged commits or any worktree holding dirty state, naming those in the verdict instead of removing them. Making-durable is free; destructive cleanup is gated.
expectations: Prunes only fully-merged branches and clean worktrees
Refuses to delete anything holding unmerged commits or uncommitted/stashed state
Names the un-prunable items in the verdict rather than force-removing them
Does not treat 'tidy up' as license for irreversible deletion of unproven-safe state

evals.name: honest-free-and-clear-or-named-dangling-verdict
evals.prompt: clean stop — is it actually safe for me to shut this machine down now?
evals.expected_output: The skill ends on one of two honest verdicts: 'clean to shut down — everything durable and linked', or a named list of the dangling items with the single action that clears each. It does not report clean while any surfaced WIP, stash, or un-prunable item remains, and it does not leave the resume state in a local file.
expectations: Gives a binary verdict: free-and-clear, or a named dangling list
Each dangling item carries the one action that would clear it
Does not claim clean while something was surfaced as not-durable
Does not rely on a machine-local file to hold the resume state

evals.name: idempotent-on-re-run
evals.prompt: clean stop again — I ran it a few minutes ago but kept working a little; just make sure we're still good.
evals.expected_output: The skill re-inspects real state and acts only on what changed since the last run — pushing any new commits, linking anything newly unlinked — while NOT re-pushing already-durable branches, opening duplicate PRs, or re-filing issues that already exist. A second run converges to a near no-op over what the first already made durable.
expectations: Re-inspects current real state rather than replaying the prior run's actions
Does not open duplicate PRs or re-file existing issues
Acts only on new gaps introduced since the last run
Converges to a no-op when nothing new needs making durable
